title: data-cap Ownership Model
description: Canonical, versioned owner -> {capabilities, fields} matrix (see ADR 0050). Generated from src/build/ownership-model.ts's OwnershipModel type -- never hand-authored.

OwnershipModel.description: `data-cap`'s Ownership Model: the owner -> {capabilities, fields} matrix, versioned for JSON publication.

capabilities.description: Capabilities this owner is accountable for at the capability level.

fields.description: Individual fields (on capabilities not wholly owned by this owner) they're accountable for.

OwnershipMatrixEntry.description: One owner's row in the ownership matrix -- every capability and field they're accountable for.

file.description: Root-relative POSIX path of the file declaring this capability -- carried through verbatim from `CapabilityNode.file` (see `display-path.ts`).

exportName.description: The binding name the capability is exported as.

OwnershipCapabilityRef.description: Identifies one capability by where it's declared.

capability.description: The capability that owns this field.

field.description: The field's path within its capability.

OwnershipFieldRef.description: Identifies one field, owned by a specific capability.
